name: Structured extraction to JSON
description: Pull typed fields out of messy text (invoices, emails, receipts) as JSON. Graded field-by-field.
system: Extract the requested fields from the text. Respond with a single JSON object using exactly the keys requested. Use numbers for amounts, null when a field is absent. No prose.

items.prompt:

Text: INVOICE #INV-2291 from Northwind Traders. Amount due: 1,250.00 EUR by 30 Nov.
